scope: Independent full-raster observation of frozen reference, delivered still and both movie samples; no rerender
recipe: Read every frozen reference/still/movie PNG through the profile-aware sRGB observer; measure per-channel absolute byte deltas over the full 128x64 canvas. A pixel exceeds 8 if any channel does. Diagnostic fringe uses the existing 2px/16px boundary mask; no pixels are excluded from the reported full-raster maximum or count.
